scope: Main cohort only: 80 cases x E/K1/C19, exactly240 primary [0,600) rows; no duplicate registered_full rows
DG_support_semantics: Positive electrical-work receipt intervals form an observed interval envelope. Overlap with saved critical material-loss intervals is contemporaneous bus-level evidence; not exact DG on-time, source-to-priority energy allocation or a no-DG counterfactual.

emissions.boundary: operational CO2 only; site fuel combustion plus location-based purchased electricity; not CO2e/lifecycle/avoided emissions

direction_numeric_tolerances.meaning: Post-analysis direction labels only, no change to physical/service failure criteria

units.cost: historical/illustrative model USD, not current hospital prices
